cues.headline: What a pass!
cues.body: Teo Ashworth just played the hardest pass of the match so far.

cues.headline: Harbor City are on top
cues.body: Harbor City are on top: leaving Elmstead Wanderers just 4.7 passes per defensive action, recovering the ball 2 times in the final third and winning the ball back in the opposition half 3 times in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: GOAL! Yann Falkner!
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers score! It's Harbor City 0–1 Elmstead Wanderers. Against the run of play: Harbor City were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 5.6 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: Pau Lindqvist scores!
cues.body: Get in! Harbor City 1–1 Elmstead Wanderers. The broken game finally produced a goal. It came 6 seconds after Harbor City won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Harbor City have taken over
cues.body: The game is going Harbor City's way: recovering the ball 5 times in the final third, winning the ball back in the opposition half 5 times and forcing Elmstead Wanderers into 4 losses in their own half in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: So close!
cues.body: Teo Ashworth should have scored: chances like that go in 50% of the time.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Harbor City 50%, Elmstead Wanderers 50%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: Harbor City turn the screw
cues.body: Harbor City are calling the shots now: leaving Elmstead Wanderers just 2.1 passes per defensive action and closing Elmstead Wanderers down 9 times in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: Teo Ashworth is everywhere
cues.body: Teo Ashworth has completed 52 passes already.

cues.headline: Teo Ashworth is the hub
cues.body: Harbor City keep finding Teo Ashworth: he is on the end of 67% of their passes in the last 10 minutes.

cues.headline: Harbor City let one slip
cues.body: That was a big one for Teo Ashworth: 37% of chances like it end up in the net.

cues.headline: It's in! Teo Ashworth!
cues.body: Teo Ashworth finds the net for Harbor City: Harbor City 2–1 Elmstead Wanderers. It had been coming: Harbor City were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: So close!
cues.body: Teo Ashworth should have scored: chances like that go in 44% of the time.

cues.headline: GOAL! Teo Ashworth!
cues.body: Harbor City score! It's Harbor City 3–1 Elmstead Wanderers. It had been coming: Harbor City were in control. It came 18 seconds after Harbor City won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Thunderbolt!
cues.body: Teo Ashworth just hit the fastest shot of the match: 120 km/h.

cues.headline: All square out there
cues.body: It's even again: over the last 5 minutes Harbor City have had the ball 45% of the time, Elmstead Wanderers 55%.

cues.headline: It's all gone wild
cues.body: The ball is changing hands 5.8 times a minute. Neither side can calm it down.

cues.headline: Quin Dravic scores!
cues.body: Get in! Harbor City 3–2 Elmstead Wanderers. The broken game finally produced a goal. It came 10 seconds after Elmstead Wanderers won the ball high up the pitch.

recap.headline: Full time: Harbor City 3–2 Elmstead Wanderers
recap.summary: A deserved win for Harbor City.
